description: Check an IFC model against an IDS file (buildingSMART Information Delivery Specification 1.0) and return, per specification, pass/fail, how many elements applied, passed and failed, and the first failures with the element and the reason. Runs locally; nothing is uploaded. Use it when the user has an .ids file, or exchange requirements to verify a delivery against.

ids.description: The IDS: local path, public URL, or the IDS XML text itself.

ifc.description: The IFC model: local path or public http(s) URL.

name: check_ids
title: Check an IFC file against IDS requirements
